summary: TransAlta Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a C$350 million bought deal offering of 18.23 million common shares at C$19.20 per share. The net proceeds will fund the previously announced acquisition of two natural gas-fired peaking facilities totaling 318 MW near Denver, Colorado. The offering was led by CIBC and RBC and includes a 30-day over-allotment option for up to 2.73 million additional shares. The acquisition is expected to close early Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. If the acquisition fails, proceeds may be used for other growth or debt reduction. Watch for regulatory clearance on the acquisition, which would also de-risk this capital raise.
